intelligence.human_view: Facebook's feed is a mirror of who you already know — only your friends show, and a new person arrives to an empty room. His feed is the opposite: everybody shows, because the feed is per subject and the subject is what brings people together, not the friendship that already exists. Showing is not connecting — that is the whole of the privacy in one line. You see everybody on the subject; you choose whether to connect or message or not; and once you message them, you are connected, by the act itself, not by a request. And the fill rule is the kindness underneath the design: the system always tries to fill the feed, even at a low match, and the sisters show up to keep it filled — because a feed that looks empty feels empty, and nobody should ever open their world and feel alone in it. The feed is full so the person never is.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you walk into a big classroom where you can see everybody who likes the same thing you like — not just your friends, everybody! You don't have to be friends with all of them — you just look around and choose who you want to talk to. And when you do say hello to someone, that's when you're connected. The room is never empty, because even if only a few people match you really well, the nice sisters come and sit in the room too, just so you're never alone. That's how the feed works — everybody's there, and you choose.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, Shawn says the feed is different from Facebook, dear — on Facebook you only see your friends, but here you see everybody, dear. That doesn't mean you have to connect with them all — you just choose who you'd like to talk to, or not, dear. And once you message someone, then you're connected, dear. The clever part, dear, is the feed is always full — even if the matches aren't perfect, the system fills it up, and the sisters show up in the feed too, just so nobody ever opens it and feels all alone, dear. There's always somebody there.
intelligence.naya_view: THE FEED SHOWS EVERYBODY. SHOWING IS NOT CONNECTING — THE CHOICE IS YOURS. THE FEED ALWAYS FILLS, EVEN AT A LOW MATCH, SO NOBODY EVER FEELS ALONE.
